name: SSL 3 Kungsbacka 2017
information: This is the third competition of the Swedish Speedcubing League 2017. The competition is open to everyone but limited to 110 competitiors due to venue constraints. Visitors are very welcome during the competiton. Registration will happen on this WCA-page and is not considered complete before we have recieved the payment of the entry fee which has been set to 150 SEK. For more information, plese visit the competition website.
